description: SiteGPT builds AI customer-support chatbots trained on your website content. This plugin connects your assistant to your SiteGPT account over MCP with browser-based OAuth. Three tools cover the platform: search finds the right API operation in the catalog, execute_read fetches your data (chatbots, conversations, leads, usage), and execute_write makes changes (create chatbots, add knowledge sources, update prompts and settings). Reads run without confirmation prompts; writes always ask first. Every call is limited to the account and permissions approved during sign-in.

defaultPrompt: What did visitors ask my chatbot recently?
